task_id: R-01 / noninvasive in-circuit U2 acquisition review

owner_constraint.statement: Owner will not consider chip removal because of risk on the dense board and requests another method.
owner_constraint.active_scope: Keep chips and leads intact. No chip removal, leg lifting or trace cutting in this plan. Earlier off-board fallback recommendations are historical and outside current scope.

review_correction: 10k/5.6k pull-up results fail to demonstrate reliable unused-U1 deselection, but do not prove all noninvasive alternatives exhausted. No guarantee an in-circuit alternative will succeed.

owner_current_state.Pi: On; same boot independently verified after read.
owner_current_state.access: Owner supplied U1pin1/3-toVCC and actual reset-pair resistances in response to direct-pin checks; latter requested U2clip temporarily off.
owner_current_state.wiring: U2clip; unusedU1pin3 via nominal10k toP1ground, contact1.5ohm; owner freshly confirmed setup, reset held0.021V before/after capture.

candidates.name: Unused U1 HOLD#
candidates.documented_behavior: If enabled and applicable to current protocol, pauses communication and releases data outputs without requiring deselection.
candidates.qualification: Function may be disabled by NVCR/EVCRbit4, QIO-SPI or DTR. Need independent U1 wiring, rail/loading/contact qualification and empirical output/read validation. Board independence/function not established; no grounding or register write selected.

candidates.name: Unused U1 dedicated RESET#
candidates.qualification: Independent U1 control/net loading and current device state must be established. Historical breakout-reset readings with successful identification remain unresolved and are not current package-pin validation. No reset assertion selected.

other_board_option.basis: Vendor documents disabling switches via enable control.
other_board_option.limits: Actual CS route and safe accessible control/supply mapping unresolved; prior completed header/U4 scans and inaccessible fine-probing are not restarted. No selector/enable jumper selected.

first_new_checks.status: Owner returned numerical resistance measurements under requested unpowered procedure
first_new_checks.procedure: Verify P1pin1-to-pin2 residual0VDC before ohms. Then black at P1headerpin1/VCC, red sequentially actual U1pin1/HOLD# and actual U1pin3/RESET#. Report numerical ohms/OL; retain wiring.
first_new_checks.purpose: Screen for near-zero ties to flash VCC before considering any drive. These in-circuit equivalents do not establish discrete resistor values or independent control from U2.
first_new_checks.later_requirements: If viable, establish U1/U2 control-net independence using genuinely accessible verified endpoints, qualify driver/loading and secure contact, then separately plan limited no-clock control. No generic scan or speculative ground jumper.
first_new_checks.interpretation: Neither reported path is near-baseline VCC continuity. These are in-circuit readings, not identified resistor values and not proof of independent U1/U2 control. Residual0V procedure requested; numerical residual not separately supplied.

agent_hardware_actions: None. Source/evidence review and repository maintenance only; no GPIO/SPI/SSH/programmer/array access or new powered experiment.

reset_pair_check.requested_setup: Pi unplugged; residual0V before ohms. Temporarily release only U2springclip, leave its wires attached and U1grabber/5.6k retained; measure actual U1pin3 to actual U2pin3.
reset_pair_check.interpretation: No low-resistance reset-to-reset connection shown in this unpowered setup. Does not establish powered independence, device state or output release. Reset candidate remains plausible and needs qualification.
reset_pair_check.physical_limits: Do not probe beneath covered U2legs or assume inaccessible clip contacts are available. Temporary clip removal leaves both chips soldered/intact.

next_step.status: First U2block passed repeatability and exact reference comparison
next_step.next: Qualify multi-address/transfer-shape path before full read pair; leave physical reset connection still.

powered_control_baseline.setup: Requested U2clip refit, existing U1pin7 grabber/5.6k retained, Pi-only power, DCvolts.
powered_control_baseline.interpretation: RESET is high in this current package-pin measurement (nominalVIHmin1.2474V). HOLD level alone does not establish enabled function. Earlier October25 breakout-reset0–0.001V remains historical/unresolved and is not the current package-pin level.

reset_pulldown_trial.status: DC reset qualification and first bounded U2read completed; wider validation pending
reset_pulldown_trial.basis: U1RESET-toVCC5.67Mohm and reset-to-reset15.96Mohm show no hard unpowered ties; nativeU1RESET1.732V at VCC1.782V provides powered baseline. These observations permit a limited-load qualification but do not prove powered independence or output release.
reset_pulldown_trial.target: Unused U1 physicalpin3/RESET#, while programmer clip remains U2
reset_pulldown_trial.connection: P1pin2/GND -> previously measured9940ohm nominal10k resistor -> insulated grabber -> actualU1pin3/RESET#
reset_pulldown_trial.remove_old_connection: With all power absent remove added5.6k VCC-to-U1pin7 branch; move grabber from pin7 to pin3. Do not retain that VCC source on new reset pull-down.
reset_pulldown_trial.qualification: Bounded resistor current is not proof of unknown on-board-driver safety or independence. No direct reset-to-ground tie, voltage increase, Pi3.3V/5V, TPM/fuse/OTP/security changes or firmware write. No WRITE/PROGRAM/ERASE or competing programmer selected in this session.
reset_pulldown_trial.owner_instructions: Shut down/unplugPi; verify P1residual0V before changing any wire. Assemble stated path with clip unchanged, secure single-leg fit/clearance. Check actualU1pin3 to resistor grabber-side leg is low resistance; report reading and leave Pi off. New contact must be verified before powered trial.
reset_pulldown_trial.later_gate: Only after contact/fit checked, meter DCV and Pi-only power to measure actual reset and VCC. At previous1.782V nominalVILmax0.5346V; require clear low margin, not a boundary reading. Supply stability plus lowRESET does not alone establish accurate U2 data; bounded RDID and cross-address/read-shape validation remain necessary.
reset_pulldown_trial.cleanup: Make all attachment/removal changes with Pi supply unplugged/residual0V; keep a powered reset connection still.
reset_pulldown_trial.source_notes: Micron pp12/14 dedicatedRESET/internalpullup/output release; Table47 thresholds. P76 notesRESET disabled during startup tVSL, so steady DC is not proof of reset coverage or waveforms throughout power ramp.
reset_pulldown_trial.agent_hardware_actions: None; new reset assertion not reported yet.

assembly_contact_result.requested_endpoints: Actual U1pin3/RESET# to resistor leg attached to grabber, under requested unpowered assembly procedure
assembly_contact_result.interpretation: Low-resistance contact acceptable for passive10k reset pull-down. Full wiring/secure single-leg fit and old5.6k removal are conditions of next power-up instruction; no powered reset result yet.

powered_test_request.conditions: Old5.6k branch removed; known10k fromP1pin2/GND toU1pin3; secure single-leg grabber and complete circuit. Switch meter DCvolts before Pi-only power; router/other-cable/CR2032/CH341A isolation retained.
powered_test_request.measurements: BlackP1pin2/GND; redP1pin1/VCC then redactual10k resistor grabber-side leg (reset node). Report both voltages, leave powered wiring still, no read.
powered_test_request.limits: Resistor-node voltage is a measured endpoint;1.5ohm contact supports equivalence to chip reset within small DC drop, not direct waveform proof. No CS/SPI/array operation follows automatically.

reader_preparation_review.action: Read existing source only; no execution/import/deployment
reader_preparation_review.behavior: Existing U2 wrapper uses shared capture with20bb19 identification gate before each of two fixed4KiB samples at001f2000. Only0x9f RDID/0x13 native4-byte READ in capture.
reader_preparation_review.limitations: First diagnostic only; no whole-array accuracy/bank identity/complete backup inferred. Cross-address and transfer-shape qualification remains after initial result. Reset/supply/physical gates not yet passed.
